verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe trigger-based workflows firing on record changes, schedules, manual actions, or webhooks, chaining record operations, sending emails, HTTP requests (e.g., Slack alerts), code, branches, and delays, with worked examples like 'Send Slack alerts when a deal reaches a certain stage' and 'Auto-enrich new contacts with data from external APIs.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the workflow builder works reliably in practice beyond first-party docs (community feedback only speaks to general alpha-stage issues, not workflows specifically).
